about: Shared cases: each YAML here, and whether Pointview accepts it (and, if not, the start of what it says). The apps repo's check and Pointview's parser must give the same answer for every case. A relative launch is the one difference: Pointview accepts it for its own built-in apps only, the store never.

cases.detail: launch must be a quoted https address
launch must be a quoted https address
the app must fit people, groups or both
each connection's role must be provider or consumer
view is only for an app Pointview serves
